outline: 介紹氣體的物理性質，熱力學第一、第二與第三定律，化學反應之熱能變化與動力學，以及系統中的相平衡。
schedule:
02/24  Chap. 0  Introduction and Background
03/03-03/24 Chap. 1 Chap. 21
• The states of gases
• The gas laws
• The kinetic model of gases
• Real gases
03/31   1st Examination
04/07-04/28  Chap. 2
• The First Law:
--- Work, heat, and energy
--- Expansion work
--- Heat transactions
--- Enthalpy
--- Adiabatic change
--- Standard enthalpy changes
--- Standard enthalpies of formation
--- The temperature dependence of reaction enthalpies
• The First Law: State functions and exact differentials
05/05  2nd Examination
05/12-06/02   Chap. 3
• The Second Law:
--- The dispersal of energy
--- Entropy
--- Entropy changes accompanying specific processes
• From Second Law to Third Law:
--- The Third Law of thermodynamics
--- The Helmholtz and Gibbs energies
--- Standard molar Gibbs energies
• The machinery combining the First and Second Law
06/09    Final Examination
06/23    Make-up Day
